subject.title: fix(parallel): resolve env search key refs

question: Is mocked trusted-endpoint dispatch proof sufficient for this pre-network credential-resolution fix, or must a live Parallel request using an env-backed SecretRef be demonstrated?
rationale: The tests observe the exact outbound credential header and fail-closed no-dispatch path, but repository policy normally requires live external-API proof and the contributor does not have a usable Parallel credential.

options.title: Require live Parallel proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until redacted live output shows a real Parallel search succeeds with an env-backed SecretRef.

options.title: Approve a proof override
options.body: Explicitly accept the dispatch tests because they fully observe the changed behavior before external response handling.

recommendation.title: Require live Parallel proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until redacted live output shows a real Parallel search succeeds with an env-backed SecretRef.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and live-verified the Parallel provider, making them the strongest feature-history owner for this proof-sufficiency decision.
